definitions.explanation: Free from impurity or contamination, whether physical (clear water, clean air) or moral/spiritual (pure heart, innocent character). Has an elevated, literary tone.

examples.japanese: {清|きよ}らかな{水|みず}が{流|なが}れている。
{彼女|かのじょ}の{清|きよ}らかな{歌声|うたごえ}に{心|こころ}を{打|う}たれた。
examples.english: I was moved by her pure singing voice.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{奥|おく}には{清|きよ}らかな{空気|くうき}と{美|うつく}しい{自然|しぜん}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: Deep in the mountains, clean air and beautiful nature remain.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat elevated word. More poetic and formal than きれいな (clean, pretty). Often used in descriptions of nature, spiritual contexts, and literary prose.

Related to the verb {清|きよ}める (to purify) and the noun {清|きよ}さ (purity/cleanliness).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清|きよ}らかな{水|みず}: pure water
- {清|きよ}らかな{心|こころ}: pure heart
- {清|きよ}らかな{空気|くうき}: clean air
- {清|きよ}らかな{流|なが}れ: clear stream
